Chapter 314: Chapter 14: The Second Chikun Star Lord, Convening of the Star Alliance Conference (Please Subscribe)

Wanyang Holy Son was somewhat bewildered.

He almost thought he had heard wrong.

But at his level, it was impossible to mishear.

The black-haired elder had indeed said “It is the Peak Master of Thirteen Peaks who has stepped into Seventh Rank.”

This was beyond doubt.

So, Wanyang Holy Son could only wonder, had the black-haired elder misspoken?

...

For instance, had he mistakenly added the word ‘three’, and it was actually the Peak Master of Ten who had advanced to Seventh Rank?

“Your Highness, when I first received this message, I also found it absurd, but afterwards it was confirmed repeatedly, over and over again, the result was the same…”

The black-haired elder spoke cautiously.

He was well aware of how desperately Wanyang Holy Son had wanted to battle the Peak Master of Thirteen Peaks, and how deeply the challenge at the limit of Fifth Rank had impacted Wanyang Holy Son.

All along, Wanyang Holy Son had been on a smooth path, endowed with the “Nine Yang Divine Meridian” and further supported by Wanyang Star Lord’s cultivation.

This made Wanyang Holy Son far ahead of his peers.

However,

on that stage,

the Peak Master of Thirteen Peaks shattered Wanyang Holy Son’s confidence with three slaps.

That overwhelming battle made Wanyang Holy Son admit defeat and immediately begin closed-door cultivation, striving to reach Sixth Rank.

Compared to other Evolvers, Wanyang Holy Son’s “Nine Yang Divine Meridian,” upon stepping into Sixth Rank, would undergo a transformation, something not found in other Sixth Rank Evolvers.

It was precisely because of this.

Knowing Lin Yuan’s formidable strength, which was displayed at the peak of Fifth Rank, and would only be more frightening after advancing to Sixth Rank,

Wanyang Holy Son still confidently initiated a challenge request.

However, Lin Yuan declined several times, which puzzled Wanyang Holy Son.

And now…

Wanyang Holy Son fell silent.

His consciousness began connecting to the virtual network.

He quickly saw the announcement issued by Red Kun Lineage.

Below the announcement, countless Evolvers left comments, all shocked by the Peak Master of Thirteen Peaks stepping into Seventh Rank.

Wanyang Holy Son carefully read through the announcement.

And read it several times over before sitting down again.

“The Peak Master of Thirteen Peaks…”

Wanyang Holy Son’s gaze was complex.

He did not doubt the authenticity of the announcement.

Such announcements released by Red Kun Lineage carry high authority, undergoing multiple verifications, and ultimately must be authorized by the Star Lord before their release.

Since Red Kun Lineage dared to issue this announcement and so much time had passed without any changes,

this meant the Peak Master who stepped into the Seventh Rank is indeed the Peak Master of Thirteen Peaks.

Given the status of Chikun Star Lord, there was no need to lie about who had advanced to Seventh Rank, as it would soon become evident.

“How could it be this fast…”

Wanyang Holy Son was somewhat lost, stepping into Seventh Rank wasn’t something one could just decide to achieve, it required sufficient accumulation and inherent foundation.

Wanyang Holy Son believed he had enough accumulated foundation, but even attempting to reach Seventh Rank would need at least ten to several decades.

This was despite the fact that Wanyang Holy Son had been sealed in a ‘Wanyang True Crystal’ and cast into a star to sleep for nearly a hundred years upon birth.

Effectively, during those hundred years, Wanyang Holy Son was always in a state of cultivation,

but all that cultivation simply accumulated into his foundation, just awaiting his transition to Sixth Rank to gradually come to fruition.

“To think I still wanted to challenge him?”

Wanyang Holy Son’s smile was somewhat mocking. He had wondered why the Peak Master of Thirteen Peaks had repeatedly declined his requests.

Could it be that he was scared?

Now it seemed that the Peak Master probably felt that accepting the challenge would be bullying him.

“Your Highness, you… You’re alright?”

The black-haired elder asked tentatively, worried that with Wanyang Holy Son’s pride, he might not recover from this blow.

“Don’t worry about me.”

Wanyang Holy Son shook his head.

Looking at the black-haired elder, he said, “Go request a piece of ‘Wanyang True Crystal’ from the teacher. I want to enter the star’s interior for cultivation.”

The temperature inside a star is many times that of the surface. Wanyang Holy Son, with his physical constitution, could manage to stay on the surface of a star for a while,

but to dare enter the interior of a star would be suicidal.

Yet,

by relying on himself, unable to withstand the high temperatures inside the star, he could still use external objects,

like the ‘Wanyang True Crystal,’ a fire system rarity, to help Wanyang Holy Son delve deeper into the star.

With the terrifying heat and flames inside the star, even with the buffering isolation of Wanyang True Crystal, Wanyang Holy Son would endure endless pain, and a slight mishap could turn him to ash.

When Wanyang Holy Son was first born, he was sealed into a ‘Wanyang True Crystal’ and thrown into a star’s interior because Wanyang Star Lord used other methods.

But that kind of method cannot be used a second time, so now, even with the protection of ‘Wanyang True Crystal,’ Wanyang Holy Son entering the interior of a star must still face a life risk.

“Your Highness… t-this is…”

The black-haired elder hesitated.

“Just do as I say.”

Wanyang Holy Son’s gaze was determined.

So what if the Peak Master of Thirteen Peaks entered Seventh Rank?

Give him five or ten years to cultivate painfully within the star, and he, too, could step into Seventh Rank.

At that time, he, Wanyang Holy Son, would again challenge the Peak Master of Thirteen Peaks.

…

Chikun Main Star.

Deep within the Thirteen Peaks Great Hall.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, his consciousness connected to the Virtual World.

Personal space.

The form of Lin Yuan appeared out of thin air.

After syncronizing his power level, Lin Yuan’s physical soul in the Virtual World also reached the Seventh Rank tier.

And with no difference from reality, deep within his Dantian Qi Sea, a Taiji small world slowly revolved.

“Simulate a cosmic environment.”

With a slight thought from Lin Yuan, the surroundings began to change.

A constellation appeared, a massive star emitting light and heat in the distance, while twelve planets revolved around it.

“Whew.”

Lin Yuan withdrew his gaze.

For a Seventh Rank Evolver, only under the cosmic starry skies could they fully unleash their capabilities, as ordinary planets rather serve as shackles.
